concept.concept: A drooping houseplant with a worried face and the text 'Did I Water You Too Much Or Not Enough — A Horror Story'
concept.audience: Millennial and Gen Z houseplant collectors who anthropomorphize their plants
concept.rationale: Plant parent identity merchandise is proven with strong gifting patterns; horror-story framing adds fresh humor angle not saturated in current market listings

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Did I Water You Too Much Or Not Enough — A Horror Story" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a potted houseplant with drooping wilted leaves, featuring a simple worried face with wide anxious eyes and a concerned mouth expression. The plant sits in a ceramic pot. Bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism. Limited palette: sage green leaves, terracotta pot, cream face, dark charcoal details, on a plain white background. Single centered composition with generous margin. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: Did I Water You Too Much Or Not Enough — A Horror Story
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif, black text, arched in two lines below the plant illustration

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Did I Water You Too Much Or Not Enough — A Horror Story' is original, descriptive humor with no known trademark associations. The concept of a worried drooping houseplant is a generic illustration idea with no connection to any protected character, brand, celebrity, or slogan. The 'A Horror Story' framing is a common comedic device applied broadly and is not associated with any specific protected property in this context. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: The text reads exactly 'DID I WATER YOU TOO MUCH OR NOT ENOUGH — A HORROR STORY', correctly spelled and complete. The artwork is a clean, original cartoon of a drooping potted plant with a worried face on a plain background — no IP concerns, no quality issues, suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Plant Parent Mug | Funny Houseplant Watering Anxiety Design
listing.description: For every houseplant collector who's agonized over watering schedules, this mug speaks the truth: 'Did I Water You Too Much Or Not Enough — A Horror Story.' Features a drooping houseplant with a worried expression that perfectly captures the plant parent experience. Ceramic dishwasher-safe design works great for your morning coffee or tea before plant check-ins. Perfect for gifting to friends with thriving plant collections, apartment gardeners, or anyone who talks to their plants. Combines millennial humor with genuine plant care relatability.
